# Radashi

> A TypeScript utility toolkit with lightweight, readable, performant, and robust functions.
>
> - Tree-shakeable, dependency-free, type-safe
> - Full test coverage, actively maintained
> - https://radashi.js.org

For complete documentation of each function, see [llms-full.txt](https://radashi.js.org/llms-full.txt).

## Array

Array manipulation and transformation

- [alphabetical](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/alphabetical): Sorts an array of objects alphabetically by a property
- [boil](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/boil): Reduce a list of items down to one item
- [cartesianProduct](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/cartesianProduct): Perform a Cartesian product of arrays
- [castArray](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/castArray): Cast a value into an array
- [castArrayIfExists](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/castArrayIfExists): Cast a non-nullish value into an array
- [cluster](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/cluster): Split a list into many lists of the given size
- [concat](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/concat): Flattens and filters nullish values from arguments
- [counting](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/counting): Creates an object with counts of occurrences of items
- [diff](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/diff): Create an array of differences between two arrays
- [first](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/first): Get the first item from a list
- [flat](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/flat): Flatten an array of arrays into a single dimension
- [fork](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/fork): Split an array into two arrays by a condition
- [group](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/group): Categorize elements from an array into distinct groups
- [intersects](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/intersects): Determine if two arrays have a common item
- [isArrayEqual](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/isArrayEqual): Checks if two arrays are equal in length and content
- [iterate](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/iterate): Iterate over a callback n times
- [last](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/last): Get the last item from a list
- [list](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/list): Create a list with specific items
- [mapify](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/mapify): Convert an array to a map
- [merge](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/merge): Combine two lists overriding items in the first
- [objectify](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/objectify): Convert a list to a dictionary object
- [pluck](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/pluck): Map an array of objects to an array of arrays
- [remove](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/remove): Filter an array by removing elements that satisfy a predicate function
- [replace](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/replace): Replace an item in an array
- [replaceOrAppend](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/replaceOrAppend): Replace item in array or append if no match
- [select](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/select): Filter and map an array
- [selectFirst](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/selectFirst): Find and map the first array element meeting a condition
- [shift](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/shift): Shift array items by n steps
- [sift](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/sift): Remove all falsy items from list
- [sort](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/sort): Sort a list of items by a numerical property or value
- [toggle](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/toggle): Toggles an item's existence in an array
- [unique](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/unique): Remove duplicates from an array
- [unzip](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/unzip): Group array elements by their index position across the input arrays
- [zip](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/zip): Combine multiple arrays in sets
- [zipToObject](https://radashi.js.org/reference/array/zipToObject): Combine multiple arrays in sets

## Async

Async/await utilities and control flow

- [all](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/all): Await many promises
- [defer](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/defer): Defer work until an async function completes
- [guard](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/guard): Make an async function return undefined if it rejects
- [map](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/map): Map an array with an async function
- [parallel](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/parallel): Parallelize async operations while managing load
- [queueByKey](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/queueByKey): Queues async function calls by key to ensure sequential execution per key
- [reduce](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/reduce): Reduce an array with an async function
- [retry](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/retry): Retry an async function when it fails
- [sleep](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/sleep): Asynchronously wait for time to pass
- [timeout](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/timeout): Create a promise that rejects after some time
- [toResult](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/toResult): Converts a PromiseLike to a Promise<Result>
- [tryit](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/tryit): Convert a function to an error-first function
- [withResolvers](https://radashi.js.org/reference/async/withResolvers): Ponyfill for Promise.withResolvers()

## Curry

Function composition and partial application

- [chain](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/chain): Create a chain of function to run in order
- [compose](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/compose): Create a composition of functions
- [debounce](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/debounce): Delay a function until after a specified time has elapsed since the last call
- [flip](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/flip): Swap the only two arguments of a function
- [memo](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/memo): Memoize a function
- [memoLastCall](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/memoLastCall): Creates a memoized version of a function that caches only its most recent call
- [once](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/once): Create a function that runs at most once
- [partial](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/partial): Create a partial a function
- [partob](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/partob): Create a partob a function
- [promiseChain](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/promiseChain): Chain async functions together
- [proxied](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/proxied): Create a dynamic proxied a object
- [throttle](https://radashi.js.org/reference/curry/throttle): Creates a throttled function that limits invocations to a specified interval

## Function

Function utilities and helpers

- [always](https://radashi.js.org/reference/function/always): Create a function that always returns the same value
- [castComparator](https://radashi.js.org/reference/function/castComparator): Cast a value into a comparator function
- [castMapping](https://radashi.js.org/reference/function/castMapping): Cast a value into a mapping function
- [identity](https://radashi.js.org/reference/function/identity): Returns the value passed to it
- [noop](https://radashi.js.org/reference/function/noop): Does nothing and returns undefined

## Number

Numeric operations and parsing

- [clamp](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/clamp): Limit the range of a variable number
- [inRange](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/inRange): Verifies number within range, inclusive start, exclusive end, flexible order, defaulting to 0 if end unspecified
- [lerp](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/lerp): Smoothly transitions between two values based on a factor
- [max](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/max): Get the largest item from an array
- [min](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/min): Get the smallest item from an array
- [parseDuration](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/parseDuration): Parses a duration string into milliseconds
- [parseQuantity](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/parseQuantity): Parses a quantity string into its numeric value
- [range](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/range): Create a range used for iterating
- [round](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/round): Rounds a number to a specified precision.
- [sum](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/sum): Add up all items of an array
- [toFloat](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/toFloat): Convert a value to a float if possible
- [toInt](https://radashi.js.org/reference/number/toInt): Convert a value to an int if possible

## Object

Object manipulation and transformation

- [assign](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/assign): Merges two objects together recursively
- [clone](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/clone): Creates a shallow copy of the given object/value.
- [cloneDeep](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/cloneDeep): Create a deep copy of an object or array
- [construct](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/construct): Builds an object from key paths and values
- [crush](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/crush): Flattens a deep object to a single dimension
- [filterKey](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/filterKey): Check if an object key passes a filter
- [get](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/get): Get any attribute or child attribute using a deep path
- [getOrInsert](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/getOrInsert): Returns a map entry or stores the provided value when missing
- [getOrInsertComputed](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/getOrInsertComputed): Returns a map entry or stores a computed value when missing
- [invert](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/invert): Invert the keys and values of an object
- [keys](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/keys): Get all keys from an object deeply
- [listify](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/listify): Convert an object to a list
- [lowerize](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/lowerize): Convert all object keys to lower case
- [mapEntries](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/mapEntries): Map the keys and values of an object
- [mapKeys](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/mapKeys): Map over the keys of an object
- [mapValues](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/mapValues): Map over the keys of an object
- [omit](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/omit): Omit unwanted attributes from an object
- [pick](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/pick): Pick only the desired properties from an object
- [set](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/set): Set a value on an object using a path key
- [shake](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/shake): Remove unwanted values from an object
- [traverse](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/traverse): Deeply enumerate an object and any nested objects
- [upperize](https://radashi.js.org/reference/object/upperize): Convert all object keys to upper case

## OOP

Object-oriented patterns and classes

- [Semaphore](https://radashi.js.org/reference/oop/Semaphore): A synchronization primitive for limiting concurrent usage

## Random

Random value generation

- [absoluteJitter](https://radashi.js.org/reference/random/absoluteJitter): Returns a number randomly jittered by an absolute offset
- [draw](https://radashi.js.org/reference/random/draw): Get a random item from a list
- [proportionalJitter](https://radashi.js.org/reference/random/proportionalJitter): Returns a number randomly jittered by a proportion of a base value
- [random](https://radashi.js.org/reference/random/random): Generate a random number
- [shuffle](https://radashi.js.org/reference/random/shuffle): Randomly shuffle an array
- [uid](https://radashi.js.org/reference/random/uid): Generate a unique identifier

## Series

Series and sequence operations

- [series](https://radashi.js.org/reference/series/series): Create an ordered series object

## String

String transformation and formatting

- [camel](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/camel): Convert a string to camel case
- [capitalize](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/capitalize): Convert a string to a capitalized format
- [dash](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/dash): Convert a string to dash case
- [deburr](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/deburr): Removes diacritical marks from a string
- [dedent](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/dedent): Remove indentation from a string
- [escapeHTML](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/escapeHTML): Escape HTML characters in a string
- [pascal](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/pascal): Convert a string to pascal case
- [similarity](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/similarity): Calculate the similarity between two strings using the Levenshtein distance algorithm
- [snake](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/snake): Convert a string to snake case
- [template](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/template): Template a string with values from a data object using a search expression
- [title](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/title): Convert a string to title case
- [trim](https://radashi.js.org/reference/string/trim): Trim values from a string

## Typed

Type guards and type checking

- [assert](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/assert): Asserts a condition and narrows the type of the value
- [getErrorMessage](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/getErrorMessage): Get a readable message from an unknown error value
- [isArray](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isArray): Determine if a value is an Array
- [isAsyncIterable](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isAsyncIterable): Determine if a value is an async iterable
- [isBigInt](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isBigInt): Determine if a value is a BigInt
- [isBoolean](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isBoolean): Check if a value is a boolean type
- [isClass](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isClass): Determine if a value was declared with `class` syntax
- [isDate](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isDate): Determine if a value is a Date
- [isEmpty](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isEmpty): Determine if a value is empty
- [isEqual](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isEqual): Determine if two values are equal
- [isError](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isError): Determine if a value is an Error
- [isFloat](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isFloat): Determine if a value is a float
- [isFunction](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isFunction): Determine if a value is a Function
- [isInt](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isInt): Determine if a value is an int
- [isIntString](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isIntString): Determine if a value is an int in string form
- [isMap](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isMap): Returns true for Map instances
- [isMapEqual](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isMapEqual): Compare two maps for deep equality
- [isNullish](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isNullish): Determine if a value is null or undefined
- [isNumber](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isNumber): Determine if a value is a number
- [isObject](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isObject): Determine if a value is an Object
- [isPlainObject](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isPlainObject): Determine if a value is a plain object
- [isPrimitive](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isPrimitive): Checks if the given value is primitive
- [isPromise](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isPromise): Determine if a value is a Promise or has a `then` method
- [isRegExp](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isRegExp): Returns true for RegExp instances
- [isResult](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isResult): Check if a value is a Result tuple
- [isResultErr](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isResultErr): Returns true for failed Result tuple
- [isResultOk](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isResultOk): Returns true for successful Result tuple
- [isSet](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isSet): Returns true for Set instances
- [isSetEqual](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isSetEqual): Compare two sets for shallow equality
- [isString](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isString): Determine if a value is a String
- [isSymbol](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isSymbol): Determine if a value is a Symbol
- [isUndefined](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isUndefined): Determine if a value is undefined
- [isWeakMap](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isWeakMap): Returns true for WeakMap instances
- [isWeakSet](https://radashi.js.org/reference/typed/isWeakSet): Returns true for WeakSet instances
